stories.headline: Alibaba unveils larger AI model and new chip
stories.summary: Alibaba announced a planned model with 5–10 trillion parameters and its Zhenwu V900 AI chip, expected in mass production in early 2027. Performance and scale claims are company statements and have not been independently benchmarked.

stories.headline: Americans want stronger AI safety action
stories.summary: A Reuters/Ipsos poll found 73% of US adults think AI firms are not doing enough to prevent serious societal harm, while 55% support slowing development. Poll results measure opinion, not the probability of an AI disaster.

stories.headline: US, Denmark and Greenland to sign Arctic deal
stories.summary: A planned agreement would add two US military sites in Greenland. Trump describes permanent US control over security, while Denmark says sovereignty remains unchanged. The full text is not yet public, leaving legal implications uncertain.

stories.headline: Jet-powered drones strain Ukraine’s defences
stories.summary: Ukraine says faster, higher-flying Russian attack drones have reduced interception effectiveness and increased disruption. Casualty and launch totals are Ukrainian government figures; Moscow denies targeting civilians.

stories.headline: Saudi Arabia restarts oil bypass pipeline
stories.summary: Three sources say Saudi Arabia restarted its East-West Pipeline at reduced flow after a nine-day shutdown caused by drone attacks, potentially restoring exports from Yanbu. Saudi Aramco had not publicly confirmed the restart.
